items.title: 56706_Buddy Tate oral history interview
items.q: the name of the band was Roy McCloud's Night Owls. So he let me talk and he says...

ctx.x: And you were going to play a number.

Oh, that's right. So I tried to persuade, you know, my cousin and of course, the one that plays piano, she's still into it. She doesn't play professionally; she plays for the church, but she still can play. So the drummer says, "I doubt if I can even keep any kind of time." I said, "Well, now wait. We aren't expecting you to be -- just make some noise. People know you don't play anymore." And my cousin, the one that was the leader, I mean, like in his name -- the name of the band was Roy McCloud's Night Owls. So…
to drag you," he says, "but I'm not thinking about -- I'm not about to let you talk me into breaking my $750.00 bridge."
